profile.headline: Android Engineer at WHOOP | AI Developer Tooling | MBA
profile.summary:
Android platform engineer with over 6 years building the systems that keep a 1.5M+ device fleet running across device management, OTA and firmware delivery, provisioning, and policy. I own initiatives from problem definition through production rollout, operating across app, firmware, and backend boundaries.

Recent work balances fleet reliability and developer tooling. On the reliability side, I lead telemetry driven diagnosis and staged rollouts under formal change control. On the tooling side, I built an AI fleet intelligence agent federating five observability and control plane sources, engineered so every figure cites the query behind it.

I set engineering standards adopted across the company and maintain high-volume code review, covering 235 pull requests across 20 repositories in the last 18 months.

MBA from the University of New Hampshire | Beta Gamma Sigma

positions.title: Software Engineer II, Android Platform
positions.description:
- Shipped a read-only AI fleet agent across 14 releases, querying five sources over a 103-tool allowlist with built-in citations to replace manual queries.
- DRI for a fleet-wide traffic investigation, driving remediation from signal to rollout via custom telemetry and a four-phase experiment under change control.
- Owned the device management platform's side of a cross-team program letting a payments partner and first-party apps share signed packages fleet-wide, through beta, GA, and international launch with zero incidents.
- Built company-wide Claude Code skills for PRs, signing, and triage, hitting 115 activations across 15 departments in an 18-day window, with the lead skill drawing 92% of its use outside the home team.
- Performed 235 code reviews across 20 repositories, including seven where the contribution was review only.
- Ran a memory reduction program across seven first-party and two third-party apps and four device families, establishing the first baseline and cutting idle footprint from 448 MB to 331 MB.
- Solely delivered out-of-the-box language and font support to unblock global setup, authoring the RFC, five initial languages, and a repeatable runbook.
- Architected a mobile network-optimized OTA update system, saving a projected $750,000 in first-year data costs.
- Cut policy sync latency from 24 hours to real time by deploying a full-stack push system for enterprise clients.
- Designed on-device Mobile Threat Detection persistence layers, securing legacy hardware without updates to save $240,000 in year one.
- Led setup feature delivery, including time zone selection and update checks, for a seamless next-generation hardware launch.
- Engineered CA certificate management on Toast devices, resolving critical enterprise Wi-Fi configuration issues.
- Built system-level policy controls for third-party accessibility services, bringing kiosks into WCAG compliance for vision-impaired users.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented an Android system application that streamlined OTA updates in primary POS application by eliminating the requirement for it to initiate the update process independently.
- Spearheaded the design, development, and deployment of a streamlined solution that enables customers to configure replaced or reset devices with previous settings, leading to a time savings of over 500,000 minutes in the device setup process in 2024.
- Contributed features to the Android client for a cloud based MDM platform, now deployed across a fleet of 1.5M+ devices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led the transformation of the previously developed maintenance portal from an internally to externally facing product.
- Collaborated with management to hire and form a cross-functional team, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with business and engineering leads to conceptualize, design, and develop the groundwork for a state-of-the-art, cloud-based implementation of the Partner Integrations auto-quoting platform.
- Demonstrated leadership by recognizing and addressing weaknesses in team culture and worked closely with management to implement improvements.

positions.title: Technology Associate
positions.description: - Developed a full-stack, AWS-hosted, maintenance portal using React and Node.js that allowed the Partner Integrations team to service user permissions and API keys.

positions.title: Student Partner
positions.description:
- Hosted workshops to promote new and exciting technologies, including Machine Learning, Cloud Computing, and AI Gaming.
- Collaborated with other Student Partners and Microsoft professionals to build a community of technology enthusiasts.
positions.insights: Skills: Leadership · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Technical Mentorship · AWS Lambda · Amazon Dynamodb

positions.title: TechStart Intern
positions.description:
- Worked on an Agile squad to develop a cloud-based service using technologies such as Java, AWS, Spring Boot, and Gradle (2019).
- Developed data analysis software for IT Help Desk analysts (2018).
positions.insights: Skills: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Node.js · Agile Methodologies · Java · AWS Lambda · Amazon Dynamodb

positions.title: Intern Supervisor
positions.description: - Supervised three HighTech Bound summer interns through separate projects, scoping each and building proof of concept work to validate feasibility before handoff.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Leadership · Technical Mentorship · Agile Methodologies · JavaScript
